input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale:
The only ownership provision (§2(d)) runs one way: TrueLink retains all ownership in the Interface, which is acceptable, but nothing vests Client with ownership of the work product it pays for under the §4 Support Services, and there is no assignment or licence-back of any TrueLink IP embedded in such results. Client-side protection is limited to confidentiality treatment (§10(b)/(c) deem Client's Intellectual Property and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" Client Proprietary Information) and a narrow post-termination statement that Client "shall retain full ownership of all domains associated with Client and Client Content" — neither is an ownership/assignment provision for deliverables or for borrower and loan data. Meanwhile §8(d) grants TrueLink a worldwide right to "use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit" Credit Data with no reciprocal reservation of Client's ownership; that licence is bounded by the Credit Data definition and the Non-Competition Agreement, so we leave the bargain intact but state expressly that no other rights in Client data are transferred. As drafted the clause fails even the fallback (no perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free right to use deliverables), so we have inserted a Client-ownership paragraph with a licence-back and a no-joint-ownership sentence.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.72

proposal.summary: Add a Client-ownership provision: Client retains its Content, IP and borrower data; TrueLink assigns work product from the Support Services with a licence back to any embedded TrueLink IP; no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) only confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface, and nothing else in the Agreement vests Client with ownership of the work product it pays for under the Support Services or reserves Client's rights in its Content, IP and borrower/loan data. We have added a reciprocal ownership provision (with a licence back for any TrueLink IP embedded in deliverables) so that we own what we pay for and what we put in; TrueLink's ownership of the Interface and its existing Credit Data licence in Section 8(d) are unaffected.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. As between the parties, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers, brokers or borrowers, and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment or transfer of any such rights to TrueLink, other than the limited license expressly granted in Section 8(d). All results of the Support Services and any other materials prepared by TrueLink specifically for Client under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest therein. To the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such results or materials, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the same as part of such results or materials in the conduct of Client's business. No jointly owned intellectual property is created under this Agreement.
